import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.util.StringTokenizer

fun main() {
    val reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val n = reader.readLine().trim().toInt()
    val s = reader.readLine().trim()

    val resultDigits = StringBuilder()

    for (ch in s) {
        when (ch) {
            '0', '1' -> { /* ignore */ }
            '2' -> resultDigits.append('2')
            '3' -> resultDigits.append('3')
            '4' -> resultDigits.append("322")
            '5' -> resultDigits.append('5')
            '6' -> resultDigits.append("53")
            '7' -> resultDigits.append('7')
            '8' -> resultDigits.append("7222")
            '9' -> resultDigits.append("7332")
        }
    }

    val chars = resultDigits.toString().toCharArray()
    chars.sortDescending()

import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.util.StringTokenizer

fun main() {
    val reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val n = reader.readLine().trim().toInt()
    val s = reader.readLine().trim()

    val mapping = mapOf(
        '0' to "",
        '1' to "",
        '2' to "2",
        '3' to "3",
        '4' to "322",
        '5' to "5",
        '6' to "53",
        '7' to "7",
        '8' to "7222",
        '9' to "7332"
    )

    val resultDigits = StringBuilder()
    for (ch in s) {
        resultDigits.append(mapping[ch])
    }

    val sorted = resultDigits.toString().toCharArray()
    sorted.sortDescending()

    println(String(sorted))
}
